checked_in_validator_scope: JSON Schema 2020-12 meta-validation and structural positive/negative smoke cases
28 RGP/PEMS2 compatibility dispositions including lifecycle/state negatives
deterministic pems/1 -> pems/2 migration with stable-ID/state/provenance preservation

resolved_design_points: Bare current-state RGP decision export is limited to current PEMS decisions with decision_state=accepted.
Current RGP uncertainty export is limited to current unresolved_item records in open, blocked, or deferred state.
Historical reconstruction is snapshot-scoped; current export cannot flatten historical lifecycle/state.
Generic proposition refinement uses a distinct domain identity and reviewed supersession rather than ID/kind rebinding.
v1 observation_refs migrate only to provenance.untyped; typed roles are not inferred.
v1 depends_on migrates only to legacy_untyped; narrower dependency semantics are not inferred.
RGP compatibility binds exactly to rgp/1 and unknown majors fail closed.

unresolved_questions.summary: Whether every admitted generic observation must have primary provenance is intentionally not frozen; current Distiller evidence supports grounding policies, but the authorized compatibility resolutions did not establish a universal PEMS/2 semantic minimum.
How PEMS/2 would be serialized canonically, including whether cove/1 can encode it without a representation-contract change, is outside this tranche and must be decided before any cutover.

next_gate: Steward reviews the successor contract and may accept it, kick it back with bounded corrections, or separately authorize a noncanonical full-corpus pems/1 -> pems/2 migration-evidence tranche. Canonical migration/cutover remains unauthorized.
